message: Astra: You now propose developing the introduction; before adding detail, what does its present description of careful writing let the reader actually perceive? Does your latest expanded seasonal paragraph offer new evidence of her change, or mostly repeat its claim? Within this notebook scene, why would further thinking about the introduction earn its time compared with attempting a revision now? Conversely, what uncertainty about its contribution would make drafting premature? What observable difference in the prose would justify your choice, and could you carry out the next step you choose?
